title: Community metabolic analysis utilities for KBUtilLib (MSCommunity)
review_protocol: Written single-pass by /ai-design Draft Mode on 2026-09-23. The external research scan (Maestro task-c1a370b4, h100/codex) returned during authoring and was folded before commit. Chris reviews by editing fullprompt.md in place, annotating with (CSH - ...) or (CSH : ...) markers; `/ai-design --review kbu-community-analysis-v1` diffs the working tree against draft_commit, classifies and propagates every hunk, and recommits with a fresh baseline. research_must_read.why: Maestro task-c1a370b4. Confirms the typed-result (Q2) and per-member-overlay (Q4) decisions; supplied the cross_feeding_graph addition, the over-specification refusal, and the commit-SHA pinning. DEGRADED: every inline code span is empty, so no API name in it is quotable.

key_findings_2026_09_23.mscommunity_divergence: modelseedpy/community/mscommunity.py (718 lines) and the standalone mscommunity/mscommsim.py (881 lines, tip b5f37c4b, 2026-08-27) both define a class named MSCommunity and both are exported by `import *`. They share most method names, so the wrong import produces plausible wrong numbers rather than an error. This drove the hard provenance gate (Q3).
key_findings_2026_09_23.compartment_scheme: build_from_species_models (commhelper.py:44-140) assigns member i (1-BASED) the intracellular compartment c{i}, SHARES one extracellular compartment e0 across all members, and renumbers member biomass reactions to bio2, bio3, ... A single-organism Escher map is drawn against _c0/_e0, which is why a per-member projection is required (Q4).
key_findings_2026_09_23.abundance_is_stoichiometry: MSCommunity.set_abundance rewrites the primary biomass reaction's metabolite coefficients in place via add_metabolites(combine=False). Abundance is therefore part of the model, not a constraint, and predict_abundances(update_abundances=True) mutates it mid-analysis. This drove the non-mutating default (Q1).
key_findings_2026_09_23.staticmethod_hazard: mscommviz.py lines 37, 84, 99, 252 decorate MODULE-LEVEL functions with @staticmethod. staticmethod objects are only directly callable on Python 3.10+; KBUtilLib declares requires-python >=3.9. Verified against Python's own staticmethod semantics. Drove the _unwrap helper.
key_findings_2026_09_23.dependency_mechanism: dependencies.yaml + core/dependency_manager.py already resolves modelseedpy, ModelSEEDDatabase, cobrakbase and cb_annotation_ontology_api as GitHub-only sibling checkouts. _load_config returns the raw YAML dict and initialize_dependencies reads only 'path' and 'git' (verified at dependency_manager.py:62-141), so an added 'commit' key is inert. Drove Q5.
key_findings_2026_09_23.dependency_warning_side_effect: initialize_dependencies() prints (not logs) 'Warning: Dependency <name> not found' for EVERY missing entry. SharedEnvUtils constructs its manager with auto_init=False so facade construction is quiet today (verified locally: only the existing optional-import summary line printed), but the singleton used by get_dependency_path has auto_init=True.

verified_not_assumed: Input shape match: escher_edit.build_member_reactions takes {member: {compound: flux}} documented 'negative = consumed, positive = excreted'; MSCommunity fills each member column of cross_feeding_df from that member's net flux, branching on < Zero for consumption and > Zero for donation (mscommviz.py:130-215). Same convention, NO sign flip.
render_map_svg(..., html=True) writes BOTH the finished SVG and the interactive page in one call, with no graphviz, no browser and no network.

new_gotchas: A re-save from Escher's own web editor DROPS reaction['member_box'], so a regenerated figure silently stops matching -- Escher's schema has no box node or per-segment style, which is why boxes/colours/dashes live on the SVG.
The map JSON alone is not the figure; it carries none of the member identity.
Past eight members the categorical palette degrades with a warning; member_groups (taxon colouring) is the real answer at that size.
A member missing from one condition changes every other member's colour unless the mapping is built once from comm.member_ids.
cross_feeding_df has NO compound names -- interactions() builds a 'Metabolites/Donor' column and drops it before returning.

confront_round_2.best_catch: S10: cross_feeding_graph was specified as a networkx.DiGraph, which holds at most one edge per ordered pair -- so two metabolites traded between the same member pair would have been SILENTLY OVERWRITTEN and a caller counting exchanges would have got the number of trading pairs. Now a MultiDiGraph keyed on metabolite id.
confront_round_2.second_catch: S1: the PRD said 'thirteen' capabilities while listing fourteen -- a real internal inconsistency introduced when fluxes_by_member was added.
confront_round_2.simplification_taken: S27: run_micom returned list[CommunityFBAResult] for a single medium; now returns one result.
declined_with_reasons: S5: proposed reading drain bounds from comm.mscomm.member_biomass_drains[member_id]. NO SUCH ATTRIBUTE -- the verified path is member.biomass_drain_bounds (mscommsim.py:153). The adversary lacks MSCommunity in its worktree and guessed; implementing its version would leave solo growth reading zero, the exact failure the guard prevents.
S9: proposed binding model.notes['member_biomass_cpds'] as an ordered list. It is a DICT {model_id: [compound, ...]}, verified at mscommsim.py:239 which iterates it with .items().
S3: proposed routing SBML export through KBModelUtils.CobraModelConverter.to_cobra, which does not exist in this repo. MSCommunity already exposes to_sbml.
S15: proposed gapfill kwargs templates= / models=. Upstream's real names are default_gapfill_templates / default_gapfill_models.
S12: proposed stripping _c\d+ / _e0 from fallback labels. Unnecessary -- interactions() already strips _e0, so community ids are bare cpd#####.

S14 (proportionality, not fact): proposed Decimal abundance normalization at 1e-12 rounded to 8dp. Abundances are caller input, float normalization is what upstream does, and nothing compares those notes exactly.
confront_round_2.pattern_worth_noting: Four of the five declines are the adversary inventing an upstream API because the confront worktree contains KBUtilLib but not MSCommunity or editEscher. Its specification-tightening requests were sound; its claims about upstream symbol names were not, and its own free critique flagged this limitation honestly.

prototype_2026_09_24.defect_it_found: write_escher_svg labels metabolite nodes from bigg_id, not name (render.py:185), so compound_names does NOT put display names on the static figure -- user story 33 as originally written was undeliverable. prototype_2026_09_24.measurement: MapStyle.fitted_column_dx sizes columns from compound IDS with an 8-char default -- exactly a ModelSEED id length. Widest name measured 2.88x the widest id (270px vs 94px), so a naive post-render label swap overflows. Upstream's documented input_column_dx/output_column_dx override was verified to be accepted and widened the canvas 2292 -> 2644 when sized from names. That is what label_compounds='name' does.
new_gotchas: build_member_reactions returns members in ALPHABETICAL order, and the figure orders its member column by connectivity -- neither matches community index order.
